# Test images

Photos of ImageNet-1k classes, each released by its author under CC0 1.0 (Creative Commons Zero,
a public-domain dedication), found through [Openverse](https://openverse.org) (`license=cc0`,
`source=flickr`). Each was downscaled from its Flickr file to 512 pixels on the longer side (Pillow,
Lanczos, RGB, JPEG quality 90, metadata dropped). They are not ImageNet's images: those are pulled
at run time by the validation and never committed.
